title: Longer fire seasons mean almost half of Australian homes face bushfire risks
paragraphs: New modelling reveals bushfires will cost Australia $6 billion a year, with a single major event costing almost $30 billion.
Fire seasons are now 21 per cent longer, with 5.6 million households exposed to bushfire risk.
Large parts of Australia are bracing for a hotter and drier summer due to El Niño.
